MAINT-ARCH-S1.title: Define Service Boundaries and Contracts
MAINT-ARCH-S1.description: Refactor existing domain modules into explicit service contracts with clear input/output schemas aligned to the 4-layer modular monolith design (facades, domain services, infrastructure).

MAINT-ARCH-S2.title: Refactor Core Domain Logic into Services
MAINT-ARCH-S2.description: Extract and reorganize existing business logic (find care, evaluate care, shared services) into independent domain services per ARCH-001, ensuring separation of concerns and removal of cross-layer coupling.

MAINT-ARCH-S3.title: Align Facades and API Entry Points
MAINT-ARCH-S3.description: Update FastAPI entrypoints and application facades to route through the new service layer, enforcing the two-facade architecture and consistent orchestration patterns.

MAINT-ARCH-S4.title: Refactor Unit and Component Test Suite
MAINT-ARCH-S4.description: Update unit and component-level tests to reflect new architecture, validating service contracts, boundaries, and isolated logic without full end-to-end orchestration.

MAINT-ARCH-S5.title: End-to-End Integration Validation
MAINT-ARCH-S5.description: Validate full request flow across tool router → facade → service → infrastructure layers after refactor, ensuring no regressions in orchestration, data flow, or external API interactions.
